title: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 (USA): avoid CDON
summary: Skip two game-issued CDON calls while leaving the disc image untouched.
rationale: This release invokes SMPC CDON from two reviewed SH-2 sites. The calls transfer CD-block ownership away from SAROO's virtual-disc path and can interrupt loading.

writes.effect: Replace the first reviewed SH-2 CDON call with a NOP.
writes.reason: Keep SAROO's virtual CD-block ownership when this game path executes.

writes.effect: Replace the second reviewed SH-2 CDON call with a NOP.
writes.reason: Keep SAROO's virtual CD-block ownership when the alternate path executes.
